summary: This Form 6-K filed by Electra Battery Materials Corp contains a routine management information circular and notice of annual general and special meeting. The filing covers standard items: receipt of financial statements, appointment of auditor, election of directors, approval of equity compensation plans, ratification of prior grants, and a proposed reverse stock split. There are no special-situation elements such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or going-private transaction. This is a typical annual meeting solicitation, not a triggering special situation event.
